about: KTX2 copies of the page's textures (tools/ktx2.mjs; the webps stay the source and the fallback). files: the webp's path under assets/ (or emb:<bytes>:<FNV-1a> for a body texture inside a character's or animal's GLB) -> its KTX2 copy, kind, Basis mode, the source's sha1 (a rerun re-encodes what changed), its pixel size (src_px) and the copy's (px, multiples of 4), flipped (rows bottom-up, as TextureLoader uploads a webp) and mean (palette.js: the 32x32 sample mean of the opaque pixels, sRGB 0-1). kinds: which kinds the page loads as KTX2 (adopt, with why), decided by the side-by-side review in gen/expand/ktx2_review/.

kit.why: ETC1S for the swatches and the stone atlas, UASTC for the sign and script atlases: identical at walking distance and at the feet (kit_*.jpg)

tree.why: UASTC: side by side identical at walking distance (gen/expand/ktx2_review/trees_*.jpg); ETC1S was rejected, its alpha (22-41 dB) changes the shoots' silhouettes

panel.why: ETC1S: the finest twigs a touch softer at 1:1, the same at the panels' distance in the mist (panel_*.jpg); UASTC was 4.7x the webp's bytes

chars.why: ETC1S bodies, palettes left as webp (nearest-filtered cells): identical on the avatar close up (chars/char_*.jpg)
